$comment: What is fixed here is the *operator's* typing, not the platform's work. An assumption the
platform derives — a beta from prices, a risk-free rate from the published series at the
run's vintage, a growth or margin intensity from the filings — must be allowed to derive,
because that derivation is the product being measured. Freezing it would measure a
constant.
What must not vary is a number somebody typed, because two runs that differ only in the
operator's typing produce two valuations and no information.
CORRECTED 19 September 2026, before the round ran and before any result existed.
The rule above was right and the two lists under it were not: they were written from an
idea of what a discounted cash flow needs, rather than from what this runner does, and
nothing in the runner reads this file. The round's assumptions come from
audit/subjects.py, the platform's own proposals, and the audit policy's bounds. Where
this file and that code disagreed, the code would have won silently — which is the
failure this file exists to prevent, arriving through the file itself.
Four things were wrong. MSFT's tax rate was fixed at 0.21 where the runner states 0.18,
cited to the FY2025 10-K effective rate. MSFT's terminal growth was fixed at 0.030 where
the runner states 0.025. An exit multiple was fixed for both subjects and the runner
states none at all, so a run whose platform proposed none would have halted rather than
used 13.0. And the two beta corrections named below had no mechanism behind them: the
typed betas were still in the runner and would have fired exactly as they did in
September. That last one is now true rather than merely written: the typed beta and the
typed risk-free rate are gone from both of the round's commissions, so a run that cannot
derive them stops and says so.
The kill-gate readings above are untouched. This correction moves the recorded hash, in
this file and in the strategy document, in a commit that carries no result — which is
the whole mechanism working as designed, and is why it is safe to do before the round
and would not have been after it.
`derived_and_not_fixed` names what no typed value exists for in the round's two
commissions, so the round takes the platform's own or it halts. `also_derived_when_the
_platform_can` names what the platform proposes and the round takes as proposed, each of
which also has a typed value below used only where the gate lists it outstanding — and
recorded as a completeness finding when it is.
assumptions.rule: Prefer the platform's own derived value wherever it can derive one. Where it cannot, the operator supplies the value named below, identically in every run of the round — except for the two named as derived, for which no typed value exists in the round's commissions, so a run that cannot derive one halts at the assumptions gate instead.

corrections_from_the_corpus.subject: msft
corrections_from_the_corpus.round_value: derived from prices, or the run halts
corrections_from_the_corpus.why: The platform derived 1.068 for the same subject in the other run. A typed 0.900 overrides the product with a guess, at the single most leveraged input to the discount rate. The typed value is now removed from the commission rather than merely deprecated here, so the correction has a mechanism: a run that derives no beta stops at the assumptions gate and names it.

corrections_from_the_corpus.subject: azn
corrections_from_the_corpus.round_value: derived from prices, or the run halts
corrections_from_the_corpus.why: 0.300 is far below any plausible pharmaceutical beta and no justification in the record defends it. Left in, the round's AZN valuation would be indefensible for a reason that has nothing to do with what the round is measuring. Removed from the commission, on the same mechanism as MSFT's.

corrections_from_the_corpus.subject: both
corrections_from_the_corpus.round_value: fetched at the run's vintage, or the run halts
corrections_from_the_corpus.why: Phase 1.6 wired the macro stack so the platform fetches the published series at the run's own vintage and proposes it at the gate. A typed fallback beside that would hide the wiring not working, in the same way the typed beta hid the regression not working — so it is removed from both of the round's commissions for the same reason, and a run that fetches nothing halts.
